facts.content: Possible Lyme disease is considered in the assessment.
Asthma is assessed as well controlled on a preventer inhaler.
Allergic rhinitis (hay fever) is part of the assessment.
For fatigue and myalgias with rule out Lyme disease, the plan is to obtain full blood count, urea and electrolytes, and liver function tests.
The plan includes Lyme disease testing with Borrelia serology.
The patient is to book blood tests via the support line and agrees to this plan.

facts.content: If Lyme testing is positive, the plan is to start antibiotics according to guidelines.
